text:
anya: Heads-up — p95 on /v1/generate shows a 220ms bump in the endpoint breakdown but the overall p95 in the global dashboard didn't move. Can someone eyeball this?
ben: saw that too. is this the new routing policy rollout? :thinking:
maya: Not on my radar, no rollout yesterday night. any chance it's sampling/aggregation windowing?
anya: Possibly. I pulled the console slice for that route: p50=80ms, p95=420ms, p99=900ms in endpoint view but global p95=210ms.
leo: Could be double-counting of cold-start traces in endpoint view or the endpoint shard using a different sampler.
ben: Quick check — the endpoint dashboard uses per-endpoint tdigest rollup with sample_origin=route, global uses sample_origin=client. Mismatch likely.
maya: That's the key. We changed default sample_origin for new rollups last month. Endpoint rollups inherit route-level config, global rollups use provenance=ingest.
anya: Is that why the endpoint p95 looks worse? If endpoint includes a small noisy client cohort that global excludes, yeah.
leo: Also check the aggregation window alignment. If endpoint was calculated with a 1s window and global with 5s, percentile interpolation differences can appear.
ben: Repro script: ``GET /api/metrics?metric=p95&by=endpoint&sample_origin=route&window=1s`` vs ``GET /api/metrics?metric=p95&by=global&sample_origin=ingest&window=5s`` — compare counts.
maya: I ran the two queries for the same 10m interval. Endpoint rollup sample_count=127, global sample_count=8120. Endpoint has very low sample which makes p95 unstable.
anya: That explains it. But why is sample_count so low for endpoint? We expect it to be similar for heavy endpoints.
leo: Hypothesis: route-level sampling has a weight of 0.02 for internal test clients. Route annotation code flip? @ben any recent PR touching route-sampler defaults?
ben: There was PR #1642 that toggled adaptive sampling for route fallbacks. I reverted a tiny piece locally earlier. Might be related.
observability-bot: alert: "endpoint-p95-samplecount-low" fired for /v1/generate (count=127) at 2024-12-07T14:02:03Z
maya: If that's the bot alert, it's expected. Suggestion: surface sample_count next to percentile in the console (small badge) and gray out percentiles under N threshold.
anya: +1 for UI guardrail. We had a pager a few months ago due to noisy p99s where sample_count=4.
leo: On infra side we can: 1) sync sample_origin across rollups, or 2) increase route sampler weight for high-throughput endpoints, or 3) expose provenance in top-level widget.
ben: For short term I'll flip the route sampler to match ingest (make route sample_origin inherit ingest by default) and re-run the rollup.
maya: Also add a console tooltip: "Percentiles are computed on sampled rollups; low sample counts can make tail percentiles noisy."
anya: Thanks team. Action items: ben toggle sampler (T-0.5h), maya add UI note + badge (T-1d), leo to validate after re-rollup and close if global/endpoint converge.
ben: starting toggle now, will post logs.
ben: (log) POST /admin/rollups/recompute?endpoint=/v1/generate -> job_id=job_20241207_0034
observability-bot: job job_20241207_0034 completed, re-rollup p95 delta for /v1/generate -> endpoint p95 now 215ms, global p95 212ms
anya: looks good, close the thread once maya ships UI guardrail.
maya: will do, filing a tiny PR for the badge/tooltip.
